sampling_frame.geography: India, including remote roles explicitly open to Indian applicants
sampling_frame.role_scope: Data/analytics and closely related internship or entry-level vacancies

source_strata.selection_procedure: Sample the predefined employer/source frame during the fixed window and record every eligible vacancy encountered under the stated rule.
Use the same documented search terms and sampling seed across the named public platforms; retain the individual listing URL when available.
Search the predefined university, government, and institutional sources using the approved role scope and window.
Use only as targeted supplementary provenance sources and keep them separately reported from the main frame.

sampling_frame.selection_procedure: Freeze the source frame, search terms, inclusion/exclusion rules, collection window, and random seed before collection. Do not select records using model predictions or observed labels.

reviewers.blinding_procedure: Reviewers receive the same frozen advertisement/evidence packet without each other's labels, adjudication notes, model predictions, or test-level error analysis.
